> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-08-07

# Summary
Supporting 4 of 4 in the August 2026 low water pressure cluster. Target publish Wed 26 Aug 2026; page tracker shows it published 2026-08-12 at `/blog/water-pressure-drops-multiple-fixtures/`.

# Key facts
- Primary keyword: water pressure drops multiple fixtures. Intent: Informational (TOFU). Target 900 to 1,200 words. No byline (client direction), Organization publisher schema only.
- Core answer: When pressure dies as soon as a second fixture runs it is a flow problem, not a pressure problem: undersized supply line, scale or corrosion, summer demand, or a hidden supply leak.
- In the 2026-10-07 GSC pull this post had 3 clicks and 154 impressions over 28 days, average position 7 (from `page-tracker\perf_gsc.csv`).
- Status line: AI first draft, editorially improved and simplified; fill `[CLIENT INPUT]` blocks and verify external sources before publish. Up-link to the pillar goes live only once the pillar is live.
